coordinateSpace: Existing upper-limb core GLB baked coordinates, before factory normalization
warning: These are reproducible local-region reference centers, not segmented articular surfaces or validated joint axes. They support replacing whole-long-bone bounding-box proxies only. Do not translate real meshes or claim clinical accuracy.

evidence.supports: Head is the medial/superior/posterior proximal articular surface; tubercles are adjacent, not part of the articular head.
Capitulum is lateral over the radial head; trochlea is medial against the ulna; olecranon reaches above the articular joint plane.

proximalHumerus.method: BBox center of humerus vertices within 0.12 of superior y bound

humeralHeadSphereFit.method: Least-squares sphere fit, manually restricted medial proximal vertices x > -0.42 and y > 0.81
humeralHeadSphereFit.role: Secondary numerical check, not a segmented articular head

glenoidRegion.method: BBox center of scapula vertices x < -0.34; y 0.79 to 0.875; z -0.11 to -0.015, manually selected region excluding most blade/acromion/coracoid
glenoidRegion.role: Approximate lateral scapular articular-region proxy requiring visual anatomical judgment

distalHumerus.method: BBox center of humerus vertices within 0.10 of inferior y bound
distalHumerus.role: Distal end including epicondyles; not exact joint axis

proximalRadius.method: BBox center of radius vertices within 0.06 of superior y bound
proximalRadius.role: Radial head and neck region; excludes most shaft

proximalUlna.method: BBox center of ulna vertices within 0.10 of superior y bound
proximalUlna.role: Trochlear notch/olecranon region, not the articular joint plane

diagnosis: Existing humHead uses whole-humerus bbox x=-0.484648, roughly 0.07 lateral to the local proximal center; whole scapular center also pulls the glenoid proxy into the blade. Distal radius/ulna shaft centers similarly diverge from their proximal articular regions because the long bones are oblique. Repair procedural reference points, not all scan meshes.
